The '''YT-2400BT freighter''' was a variant of the [[YT-2400 light freighter]]. At least one such [[freighter]] flew with the [[Citizens' Fleet]] during the [[Battle of Exegol]] against the [[Sith Eternal military|Sith Eternal forces]].<ref name="Kids" />

==Behind the scenes==
A YT-2400 BT freighter appeared in the [[2019]] [[sequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']].<ref name="TROS">{{Film|IX}}</ref> The vehicle was first identified in the [[2020]] video "Every Ship in the Star Wars Sequel Trilogy" which was released as part of the ''[[Star Wars By the Numbers]]'' series on the [[StarWarsKids.com]] [[Wikipedia:YouTube|YouTube]] channel.<ref name="Kids" />
